WHY: this programme has survived three container rollbacks. The pre-run state is placed on hardware the container cannot roll back BEFORE world 1, not after.

ARTEFACTS.contains: TLMR01/code and TLMR01/out in full — every module and every pre-run artefact
a git bundle of 9f4c70c..HEAD, i.e. commits C1 and C2, replayable onto the recovered FOTSEA01 tip

VERIFIED_ON_THE_DEVICE: sha256 recomputed on the Windows side and compared; both match.

RUN_TIME_DURABILITY_PLAN.per_batch: every batch of at most 16 worlds is read back from disk, its sha256 re-verified against what was written, and the offline reader constructed on it. A read-back failure stops the run and is never papered over.
RUN_TIME_DURABILITY_PLAN.off_container: the small state — the run ledger, the read-back log, the sealed per-world records and the archive hash manifest — is exported to the device periodically. The full per-cell archives, about 1.2 GB, are exported as split bundles at the raw commitment.
RUN_TIME_DURABILITY_PLAN.resume: the runner skips any world whose opaque token already appears in the ledger, so an interrupted run resumes without re-running a completed world and without replacing one.

MEASURED_RESOURCE_FIGURES.note: measured on non-scientific fixture worlds at full horizon; resource figures only, no outcome is read from them
MEASURED_RESOURCE_FIGURES.dominant_cost: the frozen single-linkage centre classifier, which is O(k^2) in the number of Y-occupied cells and is required by the trigger itself, not by the instrumentation
